name: Windows

permissions:
  contents: read

on:
  push:
    branches:
    - master

  pull_request:

concurrency:
  group: ${{github.workflow}}-${{ github.head_ref || github.ref }}

      # Make uv use the interpreter that actions/setup-python installed instead
      # of downloading one of its own.

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:

        - python-version: "3.10"

            TOXENV: py
        - python-version: "3.14"
          env:
            TOXENV: py
          coverage: true
        - python-version: "3.14"
          env:
            TOXENV: no-reactor

        # min deps
        - python-version: "3.10.11"
          env:
            TOXENV: min
        - python-version: "3.10.11"
          env:
            TOXENV: min-extra-deps

        - python-version: "3.14"
          env:
            TOXENV: extra-deps

        # 3.15 pre-release
        - python-version: "3.15.0-rc.1"
          env:
            TOXENV: py
        - python-version: "3.15.0-rc.1"
          env:
            TOXENV: default-reactor
        - python-version: "3.15.0-rc.1"
          env:

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

        persist-credentials: false

    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

    - name: Set up uv
      uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@c771a70e6277c0a99b617c7a806ffedaca235ff9 # v9.0.0
      with:
        cache-dependency-glob: |

        # uv download one where no system interpreter is new enough.
        UV_PYTHON_PREFERENCE: system
      run: uv tool install mitmproxy

    - name: Run tests
      env: ${{ matrix.env }}
      run: uvx --with tox-uv tox

    - name: Upload coverage report
      if: ${{ matrix.coverage }}
      uses: codecov/codecov-action@fb8b3582c8e4def4969c97caa2f19720cb33a72f # v7.0.0

      with:
